correctness.rationale: Each ball below diameter is an odd circular interval. Full and pair-only triple traces yield the exact two-sided largest-gap criterion, while radius-zero witnesses settle remaining traces. Alternating pairs forbid shattered four-point supports. Even and odd diameter cutoffs are handled separately. Inclusion–exclusion over bounded positive triple compositions gives all coefficients; uniform-composition convergence and a direct simplex inclusion–exclusion calculation give the two-phase limiting density. A standalone trace checker verified 117 parameter families and 259527 supports through order 20; the proof is symbolic for all parameters.

The related arXiv:2405.07588 studies neighborhood VC algorithms, not all integer radii. value.rationale: Exact finite support enumeration beyond VC dimension is a motivated invariant for graph-ball range spaces. The theorem gives a structural gap criterion, a sharp one-quarter-circumference three-shattering threshold, complete finite coefficients including diameter parity, and two distinct nonzero asymptotic quadratic density regimes separated at one-third circumference. The density describes the actual frequency of arbitrary labeling for uniformly random triples, which a dimension bound cannot supply.
